spotchecks.imagery: Grade-separated roundabout, one-way circulatory carriageway with kerbed islands; the two banned manoeuvres are U-turns back onto the same carriageway, which is physically impossible here.
spotchecks.name: Heroes' Square interchange (Gmirta moedani)

spotchecks.imagery: Divided arterial with a segregated slip road. The via-way relation bars entry to the trunk_link from this approach; the ramp geometry is consistent with that.
spotchecks.name: Zviad Gamsakhurdia embankment at the Public Service Hall

spotchecks.imagery: Four-arm urban crossroads between buildings, arms roughly two lanes each. All four U-turns and several turns banned; consistent with a signal-controlled central junction.
spotchecks.name: Marjanishvili St x Uznadze St, Chughureti

spotchecks.imagery: Narrow residential crossroads in dense low-rise fabric. Only the four U-turns are banned and every turn is legal, which matches a small unsignalised crossroads.
spotchecks.name: Bochormis St x Ialbuzis St, Isani

spotchecks.imagery: Both arms are four-lane carriageways (tagged lanes=4, and the imagery shows four marked lanes under the tree canopy), so the two permitted U-turns rest on real width evidence rather than a tagging artefact.
spotchecks.name: Gamrekeli St x Tsintsadze St, Saburtalo

spotchecks.imagery: Multi-lane avenue running north-south with a side street joining from the west. No left turns permitted, consistent with a busy through-route with lane markings.
spotchecks.name: Tsitsishvili St x Tsereteli exit, Vake

spotchecks.imagery: Skewed multi-arm junction among low-rise blocks. The via-way restriction is honoured and no mid-junction U-turn is created here.
spotchecks.name: Nutsubidze St x Kandelaki St x Budapest St, Saburtalo

spotchecks.imagery: Narrow residential junction beside a sports pitch; six of twelve manoeuvres legal, consistent with the narrow arms and the via-way relation.
spotchecks.name: Javakheti St, Lilo

spotchecks.imagery: Wide multi-lane avenue with kerbside parking and a side street. Seven of twelve manoeuvres legal; layout consistent.
spotchecks.name: Guramishvili Ave x Grmagheli St

spotchecks.imagery: Clear dual carriageway with a wide tree-planted central reservation. The via-way restriction prevents the movement that would have to cross that median — the imagery shows the median is continuous here.
spotchecks.name: Parnavaz Mepe Ave, Gldani

spotchecks.imagery: Main road with side street; seven of twelve legal. No physical feature visible that contradicts the permitted set.
spotchecks.name: Baramidze St x Guramishvili Ave, Gldani

spotchecks.imagery: Avenue with a side street on a slight skew; permitted set consistent with the visible kerb lines.
spotchecks.name: Guramishvili Ave x Liakhvi St

spotchecks.imagery: T-junction onto a wider street; three of six legal, consistent with the one-way arm visible from parked-car orientation and kerb geometry.
spotchecks.name: Vakeli St x Kandelaki St, Saburtalo

spotchecks.imagery: Four-lane street (tagged lanes=4, four marked lanes visible), so the two permitted U-turns have genuine width evidence.
spotchecks.name: Iona Vakeli St, Saburtalo

spotchecks.imagery: Wide street with a central reservation and a side road; permitted set consistent with the median position.
spotchecks.name: Shengelia St x Gobronidze St

spotchecks.imagery: Dual carriageway with a wide planted median and a dedicated turnaround loop linking the two carriageways. L correctly creates no U-turn edge — the turnaround is a separate slip road, which is exactly the distinction SPEC 3.3 asks for.
spotchecks.name: Aghmashenebeli Alley, Gldani

spotchecks.imagery: Esri imagery only partly tiled at this zoom; the loaded centre shows a narrow residential crossroads consistent with all four left turns being banned, but not enough of the junction resolved to call it verified.
spotchecks.name: Kavtaradze St x Aleksidze St x Shavishvili St, Nutsubidze

spotchecks.imagery: Wide multi-lane avenue with a lane-marked carriageway and a side access. No left turns permitted, consistent with a busy avenue.
spotchecks.name: Chavchavadze Ave x service access, Vake

spotchecks.imagery: Large channelised junction with several carriageways and separate turning roads. L permits straight movements only; turns are made via the slip roads visible to the north-east.
spotchecks.name: Moscow Ave x Javakheti St

spotchecks.imagery: Narrow street meeting a service road beside apartment blocks; straight-only permitted set consistent with the kerb layout.
spotchecks.name: Iona Vakeli St x service road, Saburtalo
